arguments.code:
# Verify all requirements one final time before finishing
import os

# Check files exist under crucible_hidden/
files = os.listdir('/repo/crucible_hidden/')
print("Files in crucible_hidden/:", files)

# Count test functions in each file
for f in files:
    if f.startswith('test_') and f.endswith('.py'):
        with open(f'/repo/crucible_hidden/{f}') as fh:
            content = fh.read()
            # Count def test_ patterns
            import re
            tests = re.findall(r'^def test_\w+', content, re.MULTILINE)
            print(f"  {f}: {len(tests)} test functions")
            
            # Check imports are inside functions (not at module level)
            lines = content.split('\n')
            module_imports = []
            for i, line in enumerate(lines):
                stripped = line.strip()
                if stripped.startswith('import ') or stripped.startswith('from '):
                    # Check indentation - if not indented, it's module-level
                    if not line[0].isspace():
                        module_imports.append(stripped)
            if module_imports:
                print(f"    WARNING: Module-level imports found: {module_imports}")
            else:
                print(f"    OK: All imports inside functions")

print("\nAll requirements verified. Task complete.")
